figurative_meaning_en: To become emaciated or withered; to waste away
example_sentences_in_bangla: কয়েকদিনের জ্বরে তার চোখ-মুখ বসে গেছে।
দীর্ঘ অসুস্থতায় শরীরটা বসে যাওয়ার মতো হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His eyes and face have sunk in from a few days of fever.
Her body has wasted away due to prolonged illness.
note: This idiom vividly describes physical decline, often used in contexts of illness or malnutrition in Bengali culture.
